scope: Research pilot only; no production acceptance or state updates

frozen.stone_scope: One observed stone label in v12; other stone cases must not be treated as verified.

dictionary.method: Connector full dictionary exhaustive bounded edit distance; Python replay observed-neighborhood fixture agrees on every actual query. Direct raw download failed DNS; no full dictionary Python CLI replay. Dictionary includes entries beyond M-C; not a legality master.

steps: Verify archive and frame hashes, original normalized coordinate agreement, complete OCR pass coverage, source independence by visible battle continuity and user provenance.
Keep v12 frozen. Build reference from images before inspecting candidate output for new frames. Record ambiguous labels as unscorable rather than guess.

Use full pinned species/move dictionary where accessible; otherwise enumerate all actual queries using connector and demonstrate equivalence to local replay; report any unmatched or unverified queries.

Score each visible HP pair, move name, complete PP pair, message class and supported screen class by frame and slot. Empty reference mapping means no target visible; null means unscorable or out-of-scope with separately recorded reason. An ambiguous or missing candidate is abstention. Report all excluded predictions, unsupported message types, and denominators.
Report incorrect and spurious candidates separately from omissions. Precision=c/(c+w+s), recall=c/(c+w+m); zero denominator is undefined.

For a limited research pilot, require intact input provenance, independent battle, no state emission, zero wrong/spurious scored candidates and at least one evaluable target. Any missing coverage remains explicitly unverified; omission rates are reported, not silently accepted. If a required check fails, no unconditional pilot pass. Zero errors on six images is not proof of production safety.
Production acceptance is not granted by this protocol; quantitative production thresholds, diverse battles, temporal event handling, full grammar/geometry and runtime integration remain separate.
